mechanism_narrative: The sharp decline in WORKPLACES from t-2w to t-0w signals fewer commuting trips, which directly suppresses weekday shopping and restaurant visits. If this workplace weakness persists, RETAIL_REC will remain below its prior four-week average over the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES moved from -35.4 to -32.0 after a trough at -59.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean for the next 28 days while WORKPLACES remains near or below -30.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT remains below -50 percent for multiple consecutive weeks, access to central retail areas stays constrained and discretionary shopping weakens further. This threshold condition should push RETAIL_REC lower within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays below -50 week-on-week for at least 2 consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -56.4, -56.4, and -55.9 in the last three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall over the next 14 days despite TRANSIT staying below -50.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RESIDENTIAL mobility alongside falling WORKPLACES indicates more time spent near home and less time in commuting corridors. That combination should shift spending to local essentials rather than retail-and-recreation, lowering RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed positive while WORKPLACES stayed deeply negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over 28 days when RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline and WORKPLACES remains below baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in PARKS relative to the recent trough reflects substitution toward outdoor leisure. If that rebound persists, discretionary time is diverted away from shopping districts, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by 10 points or more from its recent weekly low
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS jumped from -5.3 to 21.6 and then fell back to -8.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days after PARKS rises above its recent low by at least 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain severely depressed, the city is in a restriction-like mobility regime that suppresses nonessential visits to retail venues. Under that regime, RETAIL_REC should continue trending down within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed near -56 and WORKPLACES stayed below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to drop in the next 7 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES remain below -30.

mechanism_narrative: A continued easing in GROCERY_PHARM after its recent decline indicates households are reallocating trips back to convenience purchases near home rather than leisure retail. This substitution should keep RETAIL_REC subdued over a two-week horizon.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below its t-3w level
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from 10.7 to 1.9 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises within 14 days even though GROCERY_PHARM drops below its t-3w level.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS strengthens while TRANSIT remains weak, weekend outdoor activity replaces shopping trips and retail footfall falls. The effect is strongest when the park surge is not matched by a transit recovery, making RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS exceeds 0 while TRANSIT stays below -40
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS was positive at t-2w while TRANSIT stayed below -55
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over 28 days when PARKS is above 0 and TRANSIT remains below -40.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent improvement in WORKPLACES from its trough should eventually spill into discretionary spending as commuting and lunch-time errands recover. If that recovery continues for several weeks, RETAIL_REC should turn higher relative to the prior month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises for 3 consecutive weeks from a trough
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -59.0 to -32.0 over two weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES rising for three straight weeks.
